title: Decree on the Composition and Operation of the National Tourism Strategy Meeting
title_original: 국가관광전략회의의 구성 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters necessary for the composition and operation of the National Tourism Strategy Meeting under Article 16 of the Framework Act on Tourism.

Article 2 (Functions) The National Tourism Strategy Meeting under Article 16 of the Framework Act on Tourism (hereinafter referred to as the "Strategy Meeting") shall deliberate on and coordinate the following matters:
1. Formulation and coordination of the direction of tourism promotion and major policies;
2. Formulation of a master plan for tourism promotion under Article 3 (1) of the Framework Act on Tourism;
3. Matters in dispute among the relevant ministries in the field of tourism;
4. Other matters submitted to the Strategy Meeting by the Chairperson where deemed necessary.

Article 3 (Chairperson)
(1) The Prime Minister shall serve as Chairperson of the Strategy Meeting (hereinafter referred to as the "Chairperson").
(2) The Chairperson shall select items to be submitted to the Strategy Meeting, convene meetings, and preside over them.
(3) Where the Chairperson is unable to attend a meeting, a member designated in advance by the Chairperson shall act on behalf of the Chairperson.

Article 4 (Members)
(1) In addition to the Chairperson, the Strategy Meeting shall consist of the Minister of Finance and Economy, the Minister of Education, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, the Minister of Justice, the Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Minister of Health and Welfare, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, the Minister of SMEs and Startups, the Minister of Planning and Budget, and the Minister for Government Policy Coordination. <Amended on November 5, 2019; October 1, 2025; December 30, 2025>
(2) Where the Chairperson deems it necessary in connection with any agenda item submitted to the Strategy Meeting, the Chairperson may invite the head of a relevant ministry or agency who is not a member to attend and speak at the meeting.
(3) Where the Chairperson deems it necessary, the Chairperson may, in consultation with the head of a ministry or agency related to an agenda item, invite a person who is not a member of the Strategy Meeting to attend and speak at the meeting.

Article 5 (Quorum for Meetings and Resolutions) A meeting of the Strategy Meeting shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of its members, and resolutions shall be adopted with the affirmative votes of a majority of the members present.

Article 6 (Holding of Meetings) In principle, the Strategy Meeting shall meet twice each year, once every six months: Provided, That the Chairperson may adjust the timing of meetings as necessary.

Article 7 (Secretary)
(1) The Strategy Meeting shall have one secretary to handle its administrative affairs, who shall be the Second Vice Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism. <Amended on November 5, 2019>
(2) The secretary shall prepare minutes of the meetings.

Article 8 (Submission of Agenda Items) The head of any ministry or agency who intends to submit an agenda item to the Strategy Meeting shall submit it to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism no later than three days before the meeting: Provided, That this shall not apply in an urgent case.

Article 9 (Vice-Ministerial Coordination Meeting)
(1) The Chairperson may have a vice-ministerial coordination meeting held before the Strategy Meeting for its efficient operation.
(2) The vice-ministerial coordination meeting shall consult on and coordinate the following matters:
1. Matters delegated to it by the Strategy Meeting in connection with agenda items submitted thereto;
2. Other matters for which the Chairperson deems prior consultation between ministries or agencies necessary.
(3) The Second Vice Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism shall chair the vice-ministerial coordination meeting, whose members shall be vice-minister-level officials from ministries or agencies related to the agenda item. <Amended on November 5, 2019>

Article 10 (Operating Rules) Matters necessary for operating the Strategy Meeting, other than those prescribed by this Decree, shall be determined by the Chairperson following resolution by the Strategy Meeting.
